name: ArrayContainsNoCase
description: Returns the position of the first element in the array whose string value contains the substring passed (not case sensitive), or 0 if no such element is found.
syntax: ArrayContainsNoCase( array haystack, object needle, [boolean substringMatch] )

params.name: haystack
params.description: The array in which to search for the substring

params.name: needle
params.description: The substring to search for (not case sensitive)

params.name: substringMatch
params.description: If set to true then if a then a substring match will also return true. This will only work with simple values. Passing true with complex objects will throw an exception.
